headline: United's hubs are running normally, with FAA delay programs possible later.

items.text: The hubs are running normally: all seven reporting so far today are at 86% on time or better.

The FAA's operations plan says a ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark until 9:00 PM ET, and a ground delay program for flights into San Francisco after 4:00 PM PT. Neither is in effect.
